001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.IntEventType;
008import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
009import static org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator.DecimalBounds.max;
010import static org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator.DecimalBounds.min;
011import static org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator.DecimalBounds.mul;
012import org.clafer.common.Util;
013
014/**
015 * Multiplication of decimals scaled by {@code one}:
016 * {@code product = divRound(multiplicand * multiplier, one)}, rounded half
017 * away from zero. The intermediate product is computed in {@code long}, so it
018 * may exceed the range of integer variables. Bound consistent on the product,
019 * and the factors are narrowed by the bounds of the product.
020 *
021 * @author Michał Antkiewicz
022 */
023public class PropDecimalMul extends Propagator<IntVar> {
024
025    private final IntVar multiplicand, multiplier, product;
026    private final long one;
027
028    public PropDecimalMul(IntVar multiplicand, IntVar multiplier, IntVar product, int one) {
029        super(new IntVar[]{multiplicand, multiplier, product}, PropagatorPriority.TERNARY, false);
030        if (one <= 0) {
031            throw new IllegalArgumentException("one must be positive");
032        }
033        this.multiplicand = multiplicand;
034        this.multiplier = multiplier;
035        this.product = product;
036        this.one = one;
037    }
038
039    @Override
040    public int getPropagationConditions(int vIdx) {
041        return IntEventType.boundAndInst();
042    }
043
044    private long[] exactProductBounds() {
045        long ll = mul(multiplicand.getLB(), multiplier.getLB());
046        long lh = mul(multiplicand.getLB(), multiplier.getUB());
047        long hl = mul(multiplicand.getUB(), multiplier.getLB());
048        long hh = mul(multiplicand.getUB(), multiplier.getUB());
049        return new long[]{min(ll, lh, hl, hh), max(ll, lh, hl, hh)};
050    }
051
052    @Override
053    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
054        boolean changed;
055        do {
056            long[] exact = exactProductBounds();
057            changed = DecimalBounds.updateBounds(product,
058                    Util.divRound(exact[0], one), Util.divRound(exact[1], one), this);
059            long low = DecimalBounds.lowestRounding(product.getLB(), one);
060            long high = DecimalBounds.highestRounding(product.getUB(), one);
061            changed |= DecimalBounds.narrowFactor(multiplicand, multiplier, low, high, this);
062            changed |= DecimalBounds.narrowFactor(multiplier, multiplicand, low, high, this);
063        } while (changed);
064    }
065
066    @Override
067    public ESat isEntailed() {
068        if (isCompletelyInstantiated()) {
069            return ESat.eval(product.getValue()
070                    == Util.divRound((long) multiplicand.getValue() * multiplier.getValue(), one));
071        }
072        long[] exact = exactProductBounds();
073        if (Util.divRound(exact[1], one) < product.getLB() || Util.divRound(exact[0], one) > product.getUB()) {
074            return ESat.FALSE;
075        }
076        return ESat.UNDEFINED;
077    }
078
079    @Override
080    public String toString() {
081        return product + " = round(" + multiplicand + " * " + multiplier + " / " + one + ")";
082    }
083}
